name: PingFederate Authentication Handler
description: Sample Tines story that handles authentication requests from PingFederate's Tines IDP Adapter. Customize this story to add your own authentication logic, attribute enrichment, and risk assessment.

agents.name: Receive PingFederate Request
agents.notes: Receives authentication context from PingFederate. Configure the same secret in your PingFederate adapter settings.

agents.name: Extract User Info
agents.notes: Extracts key information from the PingFederate request

agents.name: Prepare Success Response
agents.notes: Prepares the response to send back to PingFederate. Customize the attributes returned here.

usage_notes: 1. Import this story into your Tines tenant
2. Update the webhook secret to match your PingFederate adapter configuration
3. Copy the webhook URL and paste it into the PingFederate adapter settings
4. Customize the 'Prepare Success Response' action to return the attributes you need
5. Add additional actions for attribute lookup, risk assessment, etc.
customization_ideas: Add an HTTP Request action to lookup user attributes from Active Directory or LDAP
Add IP reputation checking using threat intelligence APIs
Implement adaptive MFA by returning a risk_score attribute
Add audit logging by sending events to your SIEM
Integrate with your HR system to get department and manager info
